name: Accelerated SH and Differentiable Loss Computation
definition: Optimizations for Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficient updates and SSIM loss computation to reduce training time, specifically targeting the Adam optimizer bottleneck.
summary: This method accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting training by decoupling Spherical Harmonic updates into separate tensors and fusing SSIM loss kernels to reduce computational overhead.
